culprit_citations.quoted_text: Prestige Bidco: Par AUD 72,042; Cost $46,361; Fair Value $49,457

rationale: FX03 misattributes the instrument denomination shown in the Par column to cost_currency. The raw schedule header separates Par, Cost, and Fair Value; row 5 places AUD under Par but explicitly shows dollar signs for Cost and Fair Value, and row 17 confirms the Australia cost and fair-value subtotal in dollars. Thus the extracted non-USD cost_currency flag is a rule/column-scope false alarm; the reported valuation amounts are USD-denominated.
